input: Get a pollinator-friendly plant list from a local nursery

gold.taskTitle: Get a local nursery pollinator-friendly plant list
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to obtain a curated list of pollinator-friendly plants from a local nursery.

questions.title: Which specific pollinators are you gardening for?
questions.description: Are you focused on honeybees, native bees, butterflies, hummingbirds, or all pollinators in general?

questions.title: Do you have a specific nursery already in mind?
questions.description: Is there a particular local nursery you plan to contact, or do you need help identifying one nearby?

questions.title: Will you visit in person or contact them remotely?
questions.description: Are you planning to go to the nursery in person, or would you prefer to call or email them for the list?

questions.title: What is your general climate or hardiness zone?
questions.description: Knowing your region or USDA hardiness zone will help ensure the plant list is locally appropriate.

questions.title: Is this list for a specific type of garden space?
questions.description: For example, is the planting area a backyard garden, a balcony, a community plot, or a meadow restoration?

questions.title: Do you have a timeline for when you need the list?
questions.description: Is there a planting season or deadline driving when you need to have this information in hand?

questions.title: Will you use the list just for reference or to purchase plants?
questions.description: Understanding whether you intend to buy from that nursery will shape how detailed and purchase-ready the list needs to be.
